room_rent.note: If room taken exceeds limit, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction on other expenses if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; listed modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.) capped at 50% of SI; road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for most listed conditions (hernia, cataract, hydrocele etc.); 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; alternatively a 5% no-claim discount on premium can be chosen instead — only one benefit at a time

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour hospitalisation limit not applicable for day-care

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, consumables and many non-medical items listed under excluded List I of Annexure A

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (Section 7.19 and 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual premium; 15 days for instalment (half-yearly/quarterly/monthly)

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; waiting period credit given for prior continuous coverage

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, gender change, addiction treatment
